$comment: Windy Mail ops surface — Class C (cloud). Clarifying finding: Mail's PRODUCT + ADMIN surface (webmail send/read, /api/v1/provision, account suspend/reinstate) stays OUT of this ops contract per §2 — same line Mind's /v1/chat and Search's /v1/search sit behind. Mail's account-admin mutations are product-domain business logic, not service-healing, so this remains a clean read-ops surface. Mail-specific value: /health already reports Stalwart (the mail server) + db + redis component status, so get_health natively carries the deliverability dimension. Reads bound via transport on https://mail.windymail.ai; EPT-gated. Rev 2026-07-13 (gap-closing, replicating windy-mind #60 / windy-search #61): get_logs + get_config + run_selftest SHIPPED as the /ops/* trio (auth: EPT or Pro JWT — identical citizens, per Mail's own law). get_logs is content-free BY CONSTRUCTION with Mail's hardest line: NOTHING message-derived (addresses, subjects, bodies, raw Stalwart/Resend errors) can enter the ring — fixed event vocabulary only. run_selftest exercises the infra legs (Stalwart admin, real DB round-trip, real Redis ping) with a 60s-cached per-stage verdict using `passed` (invoke-envelope rule); the FULL canary — send a real message to a loopback mailbox through the JMAP submit pipeline — needs a dedicated canary mailbox and is the documented follow-up. Mutating gaps: port the windy-mind ops-hook (#61) pattern to the Mail EC2. DEPLOY STATUS: merged; live after the Grant-gated deploy — probe before trusting mid-incident.

get_health.note: component status incl. Stalwart mail server — the deliverability dimension.

get_capabilities.note: 200 only when db + Stalwart + redis all healthy.

get_config.note: which legs are wired (Stalwart admin/JMAP, db, redis, Eternitas, Pro, OAuth bridges, cloud archive), secrets→booleans — closed 2026-07-13.

get_logs.note: content-free ring, fixed vocabulary; nothing message-derived can enter — closed 2026-07-13.

run_selftest.note: infra legs (Stalwart/db/redis) per-stage, 60s cache — closed 2026-07-13. FOLLOW-UP: full canary send to a loopback mailbox needs a dedicated canary account.

reconnect.note: components reconnect via their own pools; nothing agent-toggleable.

restart_app.note: out-of-band; port the windy-mind ops-hook (windy-mind #61 — out-of-patient systemd unit, bearer + confirm nonce) to the Mail EC2.

enter_safe_mode.note: degraded-mode is reported by /health/ready, not toggled.

check_for_update.note: wire to the Steamroller fleet version manifest (L2).

apply_update.note: SSH-free health-gated redeploy; §7. The windy-mind ops-hook (#61: rebuild + last-good rollback + sha attestation) is the pattern to port.

reset_to_defaults.note: NEVER — this service holds real mailboxes; a factory reset would destroy user mail.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: The FIRST call when Windy Mail seems broken. Component health of the mail system: the database, the Stalwart mail server itself, and Redis. If mail isn't sending or arriving, this shows which piece is down.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read Windy Mail's deployment identity — which build is serving right now. Use this to confirm whether a fix that was meant to deploy is actually live.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Report whether Windy Mail is fully READY to serve — returns healthy only when the database, the Stalwart mail server, and Redis are all up. Use this to distinguish 'the app is running' from 'mail can actually flow'.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Read system-wide Windy Mail statistics — how many accounts exist and how they break down by status (active, suspended, and so on). An admin-level diagnostic for 'is the mail system healthy at scale'. Counts only, never message content.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Read Windy Mail's recent operational events — server starts and self-test results by category. Content-free with Mail's hardest privacy line: the log can only ever hold fixed event names and category codes. No addresses, no subjects, no bodies, no raw mail-server errors — ever. Requires your passport or account token.

entries.description: [{ts, level, event, code?}] — fixed vocabulary only

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Read Windy Mail's effective runtime configuration with every secret redacted to a boolean: which legs of the mail stack are actually wired — the Stalwart mail server (admin + JMAP), database, Redis, Eternitas passports, Pro identity, Gmail/Outlook OAuth bridges, and cloud archive. Use this when mail 'half works' — a missing leg shows up as a false. Requires your passport or account token.

tools.name: run_selftest
tools.description: Actively exercise Windy Mail's infrastructure legs: reach the Stalwart mail server's admin endpoint, round-trip the database, and ping Redis — pass/fail per stage so you can see exactly which leg failed. Verdict cached 60 seconds. Note: this does not yet send a canary message end-to-end (that needs a dedicated canary mailbox — planned); pair with get_stats for traffic-level health. Requires your passport or account token.

passed.description: true only when every stage passed ('passed', not 'ok' — top-level ok is reserved for the invoke envelope)
